annotations.title: Block Out Assembly from Parts List

description: Use this when you have a list of parts with bounding boxes and positions (from a layout, spreadsheet, another tool or a sketch) and need an evaluable placeholder assembly script. Pass parts as { name, bboxMm:[x,y,z], positionMm:[x,y,z], rotationDeg?, anchors? } in mm; positionMm locates the bbox lower corner and anchors are named points in assembly coordinates. Optional connections [{ from, to }] reference anchors as "part.anchor" (including built-ins origin, bbox_center, bbox_x_min..bbox_z_max) and become fastened mates that express connectivity intent only; no wire or route geometry is generated. Returns the script (corner-anchored box solids with named connectors) plus warnings. It reads no files and cuts nothing; refine the solids with add_part/add_feature afterwards.

positionMm.description: Anchor point in assembly coordinates, mm.
Bbox lower corner in assembly coordinates, mm.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation about Z as a number, or XYZ Euler degrees as [x,y,z].
